name: Joou-sama to Koakuma
source:
Main character is sandwiched between cute childhood friend and appeal of a grown woman who compete over him vigorously.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
绿家司夹在可爱的青梅竹马奈奈绪莉菜与成熟妩媚的饭山绫之间，两人为争夺他展开了激烈攻势。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
